files.sim/systems/fac_drive7.gd: OWN, about 1000 lines, compiles. Runtime lane graph from the layout json: lanes become centrelines (lanes 3.5+ wide carry two one-way lanes, right-hand traffic); the gate column runs at the gate centre x from the gate_inner top to compound+6.6; the pad and staging plazas are a 1-tile node grid; garages go park P -> door (P+out*1.5) -> any node within 2.6 ahead; bays go front node (bay-1.6*dir) -> bay -> exit node. Clearance raster: every zone except DRIVE_ZONES, plus core, wall ring, towers, link walls, lockers, baffles; garages tagged 10+i. Routing: Dijkstra over (node, came-from) with turns <= 100 deg, then string pulling (_pull), then fillets fitted to clearance (_fit, R_MAX 2 down to 0.6), prims/pose_at. Route cache lives in w.cache.fd7_rt and is rebuilt from the saved raw polylines (V.legs). Orders: order(w,e,fid,to,who,tgt,then,gar) with to = g<i> / b / b<j> / w<k> / x. Garages are backed into (forward leg + reverse leg). 2 bays (_free_bay fills the front bay first; a 3rd APC gets st=queue). Wash: rinse stop, then continue (V.then). APCs outside approach via Movement to _ap(); outbound APCs are handed off to Movement past the gate (to tgt, or to a dispersal spot). tick: _discover (team APCs in garages -> parked, nose out), _watch_out (team APCs that are out and get a move order into the compound), _intercept (a plain move/attack_move without the fd7 key -> classify -> order), _drive (speed V_FWD 1.4, V_REV 0.5, curve speed sqrt(A_LAT*R), ACC 0.6, BRK 1.0; zone reservations on two-way lanes and the gate lane, where APCs standing in the wash hold it inbound; convoy rule at the gate by seq; look-ahead conflicts at D_SAFE 1.95 with priority by distance-to-conflict, then seq; gear stop GEAR_TICKS). order_team(w,T,aps,where) is the CnFacility hook. fd7_go: validate_command/apply_command. registered() is true only when fac_drive7.gd is in SimWorld.SYSTEM_ORDER (or the static force_on is set, for tests).
